test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper( Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

A. All mobiles are watches.

B. Some watches are not books.

**Conclusions:**

1. Some mobiles are watches.

2. All mobiles are books.
solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9432a5fa87537b6886362503a263ec9d4e4f3d63118f1080019ad16d7870c7aa.png] 

Conclusions:

1. Some mobiles are watches. → True (as all mobiles are watches)

2. All mobiles are books. → False (as it is possible but not definite)

Hence, only conclusion I follows.
